market: KC −9.5, total 48. Mahomes 31.5 attempts / 22 completions; Geno Smith 32.5 / 20.5. Walker 20.5 carries; Breece Hall 10.5, Braelon Allen 9.5.
lineup: NYJ WR Garrett Wilson is out (concussion). Breece Hall is back from a five-game quad absence with no designation. KC CBs L'Jarius Sneed and Mansoor Delane are out.
branches: If Hall is a surprise inactive, Allen is the lead back again (19+ carries in each of the last four) and the Allen read below flips.

keys.take: The Jets' ground game, the only offense they have left without Wilson.
keys.how: KC allows a league-best 3.6 yards per carry and gets leads that make teams stop running.
keys.gives: Short throws to backs and TEs. KC allows 39 RB receiving yards and 65.6 TE yards a game.
keys.counter: Geno has thrown for 252–290 in three straight. Omar Cooper Jr. and Adonai Mitchell have each had 100-yard games.

keys.take: Kenneth Walker, who gets 76% of KC's carries and averages 110 yards.
keys.how: NYJ blitzes often (39.4%) and faces 30 rushes a game, second most here, because it trails.
keys.gives: Play-action. KC uses it on 30.6% of dropbacks.
keys.counter: KC's control script. Walker averaged 21 carries in KC's five wins.

scripts.control: KC leads (84% to win). The Jets' backfield split matters most here: whoever is second in line loses carries first, and KC's run defense caps the per-carry yards.
scripts.competitive: NYJ stays within a score and can run both backs. Allen's lowest-yardage outcomes need this script to fail.
scripts.reversal: NYJ leads. Hall and Allen both run late, and Walker's carries drop to his loss-game levels (14 and 21 carries, 36 and 69 yards).

plays.cond: Final at 60¢ or less. Only if Breece Hall is active.
plays.why: Hall's return cuts Allen back to a split, against the stingiest run defense on the board, in a game the Jets are expected to trail.
plays.support: Books split the carries almost evenly (Hall 10.5, Allen 9.5). KC allows 3.6 yards per carry. Our backtest has rushing-yard Yes prices about 8 points rich.
plays.sample: With Hall active (Weeks 1–3), Allen had 10, 5 and 4 carries for 40, 7 and 14 yards: under 40 in 2 of 3. Without Hall (Weeks 4–8), he topped 40 all five times.
plays.counter: Allen out-produced Hall for five weeks (147 yards last week), so the staff may lean on the hot hand.
plays.loses: NYJ keeps it close and Allen gets 14+ carries, or one long run.
plays.vs: Beat Allen under 50 (74¢, needs 76%), which is safer but priced past our estimate.

value: Allen under 40 at 62¢ (needs 64%), better at 60¢ or less

passed.name: Kenneth Walker 90+ rush (54¢), either side
passed.why: The control script says Yes (90+ in 4 of 5 KC wins), but our backtest says No. With the two pointing opposite ways, no edge.

passed.name: Geno Smith 225+ pass yds (44¢)
passed.why: The trailing script and KC's missing corners help, but losing Wilson and KC's 18.7 points allowed (best here) push back.

passed.name: Adonai Mitchell / Omar Cooper Jr. yards
passed.why: Three or four real games each. Too few for a meaningful number.
passed.move: Target shares from the first half (live).
